title: Task spawn composes lock + worktree + DB atomically
statement: devai work task spawn with --with-worktree and/or --with-db MUST compose the execution environment transactionally: if any downstream step fails after locks are held, the upstream steps already taken MUST be reversed (worktree destroyed, locks released) and the task MUST be persisted with status:cancelled and a rollback_reason. A failed spawn MUST NOT leave the substrate half-initialized.
rationale: Articles 25 (locks) and 27 (worktree discipline) jointly assume the harness can construct the per-task execution environment as a single transactional unit. Without rollback, the loop's central state machine corrupts the substrate on every partial failure, and lock leaks accumulate.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
